# Paths the Renovate agent never merges on its own: one extended regex per line, matched
# against every file a PR touches. A hit forces the verdict to needs-human in agent.py,
# whatever the model said.
#
# The list is deliberately short. Everything else (Ceph, databases, ingress, secrets,
# monitoring, apps) is applied automatically when it is a patch or minor update, watched
# in ArgoCD and reverted if it does not settle. Listed here is only what the agent could
# not recover from, because the update can take out the agent itself or the path it uses
# to see and undo a bad rollout.

# The agent itself: its runner, its code and CI, the dev shell it runs in
^k3s-userapps/github-runner/
^\.github/
^flake\.(nix|lock)$
^renovate\.json$

# OS and Kubernetes upgrades
^talos/
^k3s-userapps/system-upgrade/
^k3s-apps/tuppr\.yaml$

# What the agent needs to see and undo a rollout: GitOps, pod networking, cluster DNS
^k3s-apps/(argocd|metaapp|userapps)\.yaml$
^k3s-bootstrap/
^k3s-apps/(cilium|coredns)\.yaml$

# Not deployed by ArgoCD, so there is nothing for the agent to watch
^terraform/
^ansible/
^packer/
